dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Uh... Huh? My eyes aren't playing tricks on me, are they? Since I can actually see you here... Have you also broken the law?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Ha! Done nothing wrong... I know you young'uns all like to save face.

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Eh, forget it. I won't ask. Though it seems we're somewhat bound together by fate, so if anyone gives you any trouble, you come tell me, and I'll help you out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's life in the Fortress of Meropide?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Do you really need to ask that? You'll know for yourself in a couple days, right?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: I used to have a buddy who really liked Bulle Fruit, and recently I saw that someone had drawn one on the noticeboard. It made me miss him all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Never mind. Poor guy's probably long since left this world. Forget it. Remember to treasure those around you, eh?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Don't be as arrogant here as you are out there. That's my advice.
